WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.76743 45.456129)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.76743 45.456129)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'residential'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.76743 45.456129)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

WITH restaurant_geom AS (

  FROM pois
  WHERE id = 14717
),
residential_roads AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM roads
  WHERE highway = 'residential'
),
closest_road AS (
  SELECT r.geometry
  FROM residential_roads r
  CROSS JOIN restaurant_geom p
  ORDER BY r.geometry <-> p.geometry
  LIMIT 1
),
road_centerline AS (
  SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS center
  FROM closest_road
),
road_elevation_profile AS (
  SELECT
    ST_3DInterpolatePoints(
      ST_Transform(cl.center::geometry, 4326),
      ST_Transform(cl.geometry::geometry, 4326),
      'LINESTRING'
    ) AS interpolated_line,
    ST_DumpAsPolygons(
      ST_Slope(
        ST_Clip(
          public.dem_us.rast,
          ST_Transform(cl.geometry::geometry, 4326),
          TRUE
        ),
        1
      )
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM closest_road cl
),
slope_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Avg(ST_Value(slope_rast.rast, 1)) AS avg_slope
  FROM road_elevation_profile, LATERAL slope_rast
)
SELECT
  ST_Distance(
    (SELECT geometry FROM restaurant_geom),
    (SELECT geometry FROM closest_road)
  ) AS distance_meters,
  (SELECT avg_slope FROM slope_analysis) AS avg_slope_degrees;
